description: Withdraw Capability Credits from the platform to your Polygon wallet address. Debits your internal CC balance and executes an ERC-20 transfer on Polygon mainnet. Minimum 1 CC (10,000 cogs). Returns tx_hash and Polygonscan link.

cogs_amount.description: Amount to withdraw in cogs (10,000 = 1 CC)

to_address.description: Polygon wallet address to send to (optional — defaults to your registered wallet)

name: withdraw_cc
